project_context.name: Raditya Putra Setiawan Portfolio
project_context.vibe: Awwwards Site-of-the-Day, premium, kinetic, deliberate craft, cinematic.

headings.styling: tracking-tighter, leading-none, large scale. Use responsive clamp sizes up to text-6xl+ for H1. No generic sizes.

mono_accent.styling: tracking-widest, uppercase, text-xs. For manifesto numbers (e.g. 01 TENTANG).

colors.usage_rules: Strict monochrome structural foundation with #22D3EE used as a rare, high-impact laser accent.

visual_enhancers.surface_strategy: Grid Borders and Tracing Beam mix. 1px subtle borders for bento boxes. Cards have no generic drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used ONLY on the sticky navbar: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F1115]/80 border-b border-white/5.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add subtle SVG noise overlay fixed to screen pointer-events-none.

grids_and_layouts.general: High negative space. Generous padding (py-24 to py-32). Numbered manifesto layouts.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Full height (min-h-screen). Asymmetrical alignment. Huge typography.
grids_and_layouts.skills_grid: Mode A 'Tetris Grid' (Bento). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-6. Mix tall and wide cards.
grids_and_layouts.education_timeline: Vertical asymmetrical layout. Left side: Timeline rod. Right side: Content.

motion.global: lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY. Framer Motion for reveals.
motion.kinetic_hero: Line-by-line masked text reveal on load using framer-motion staggerChildren and overflow-hidden wrappers.
motion.scroll_reveals: whileInView drift up 40px and fade in.
motion.marquee: react-fast-marquee. Very slow, continuous. text-8xl outline text.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale to 0.98 on tap, hover reveals subtle cyan glow.

component_strategy.navbar: Sticky, glassmorphism, z-50. Include Logo, Links, and CTA button.
component_strategy.about_section: Split layout. Left: Sticky chapter marker '01 Tentang'. Right: Spotlight portrait and bio.
component_strategy.skills_section: Bento grid with visual icons and animated progress bars.
component_strategy.projects_section: Placeholder 'Segera Hadir' (Coming Soon) with ASCII art or massive outline text.
component_strategy.contact_form: Customized Shadcn-like raw inputs (Tailwind). Submit triggers mailto: function.
component_strategy.social_links: Sleek row of icons (GitHub, LinkedIn, Instagram, Email, WhatsApp) in footer.

accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all links, buttons, and form inputs.

media.image_treatment: Photography MUST be deliberately treated. Grayscale or darkened blend modes. Spotlight gradients.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion 3D or react-spring-parallax for subtle parallax hero moment.

hero_abstract_bg.description: Black and blue abstract geometric background. Use as heavily blurred or parallax background asset.

profile_photo.description: Professional Asian man's face illuminated in dramatic low light.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required libraries: yarn add framer-motion @studio-freight/lenis react-fast-marquee @phosphor-icons/react clsx tailwind-merge
Configure Tailwind base, surface, accent colors, and custom fonts.
Hero structure: Create a Kinetic Typography loader/reveal. Use Framer Motion for line-by-line reveal.
All copy MUST be in Bahasa Indonesia.
NEVER leave a transparent background on the sticky navbar. Use backdrop-blur.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Prioritize asymmetrical layouts.
Use 2-3x more spacing to create a premium feel.
Do NOT center align the app container.
Every interaction must have a micro-animation.
Test all interactive elements with 'data-testid' attributes.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Ensure high contrast. Focus states must be highly visible (cyan ring). Include skip-to-content links.
